Smart toilets are revolutionizing bathroom experiences in Melbourne by integrating advanced technology to enhance comfort, hygiene, and convenience. These innovative fixtures often feature bidet functions, heated seats, automatic flushing, and air-drying capabilities.

Here are some smart toilet options available in Melbourne:


[Bidet Toilet Seats, Smart Toilets & Portable Bidets | Tudaloo](https://tudaloo.com.au/?utm_source=openai)
**Tudaloo Halo Smart Toilet**  
Offers sensor-activated lid and auto-flush, customizable temperature and wash modes, and a seamless design. ([tudaloo.com.au](https://tudaloo.com.au/?utm_source=openai))



[Lafeme Neovanta Gloss White Floor Mounted Smart Toilet - MyHomeware](https://www.myhomeware.com.au/products/lafeme-neovanta-floor-mounted-cisternless-luxury-smart-toilet?utm_source=openai)
**Lafeme Neovanta Smart Toilet**  
Features foot-sensor controls, automatic lid operation, self-cleaning nozzle, multiple wash modes, and a heated seat. ([royalvanities.com.au](https://www.royalvanities.com.au/products/lafeme-neovanta-smart-toilet?utm_source=openai))



[Zero Rimless Smart Bidet Toilet Suite (Whirlpool Flushing) | Zumi Bathware](https://zumibathware.com.au/product/zero-rimless-toilet-suite-with-smart-bidet-seat/?utm_source=openai)
**Zumi Zero Smart Bidet Toilet Suite**  
Combines premium design with concealed plumbing, offering smart washing functions, a rimless pan, and a seamless wall-hugging design. ([royalvanities.com.au](https://www.royalvanities.com.au/products/zumi-zero-smart-bidet-toilet-suite?utm_source=openai))



[JOMOO Toilet - One Piece Smart Floor Mounted Siphon Flush](https://www.alibaba.com/showroom/jomoo-toilet.html?utm_source=openai)
**JOMOO Smart Toilet**  
Provides automatic flushing, seat warming, intelligent cleaning, deodorizing systems, and sleek, minimalist designs. ([rndinteriors.com.au](https://rndinteriors.com.au/category/toilet/smart-toilet/?utm_source=openai))



[TL-STSF851WH - ANZZI ENVO Aura Elongated 1.28 GPF Smart Bidet Toilet in White with Remote Control, Auto Flush, Heated Seat, and Deodorizer](https://anzzi.com/products/tl-stsf851wh?utm_source=openai)
**Aura Zenith Smart Toilet**  
Features adjustable bidet spray, heated seat with temperature control, soft-close lid, air dryer function, deodorizer system, and night light illumination. ([oshonic.com.au](https://oshonic.com.au/collections/smart-toiltes?utm_source=openai))


When considering a smart toilet, ensure it meets Australian standards, including WaterMark certification and WELS (Water Efficiency Labelling and Standards) ratings. Professional installation by licensed plumbers and electricians is recommended to comply with local regulations and ensure optimal performance.

For personalized advice and to explore these options further, you can visit local showrooms or contact the retailers directly.
